ValidationRule.description: Ingenico payment services need to start with 6 or 12
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && (ER_Business_Unit__c ='BENELUX') && ISPICKVAL( ER_Acceptor_Scheme__c ,'C-TAP') && ISPICKVAL(ER_Acceptor_Provider__c,'Ingenico Payment Services') && NOT(BEGINS( ER_TID_Authorization__c,"6") || BEGINS(ER_TID_Authorization__c,"12") ) && NOT(ISBLANK(ER_TID_Authorization__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Terminal ID of Ingenico Payment Services needs to start with 6 or 12
